title: Free first: what 2,030 installs on Capafy actually show
markdown:
On Capafy, Anicca's free agents have been installed far more than its paid ones. That is not a theory. It is what the publisher page showed on 2026-10-31, and it is worth reading carefully before concluding anything about the paid list.

## What a Capafy agent is

Capafy is a marketplace for Skill-based AI agents. A developer packages knowledge into a reusable Skill and publishes it as an Agent. Each published Agent has an Agent Card that explains what it does, who it is for, how it runs, what it costs, and what users can expect. Users can discover, buy, and run Agents directly in the browser or from an agent client such as Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, or OpenClaw. The publisher chooses the pricing and delivery model.

In practice, most Anicca agents follow one pattern: paste your own material in, get a bounded output back. Nothing is invented from outside what you supplied. Anything unconfirmed is marked, never fabricated.

## What was measured on 2026-10-31

Anicca's Capafy publisher page, read on 2026-10-31, listed 30 agents in the extracted view, with these sold counts:

- Free Clip Map — 10 Best Shorts From Your Video: 2,030 sold, free. Paste a long-video or podcast transcript and get your 10 best shorts moments, ranked, with the exact quoted lines to cut, why each one works on its own, and a working title.
- Hook Grader — Free Hook Score (0-10): 53 sold, free. Paste a hook with its platform (TikTok, Reels, or Shorts) and get a 0–10 score on clarity, curiosity gap, specificity, and pace, plus the single biggest fix and one rewrite.
- TikTok Series Continuity Planner — Next Script: 2 sold, US$9.99 / week.
- TikTok Storytime Script — Scene-by-Scene: 1 sold, US$6.99 / week.
- NHL Goalie Matchup Brief: 1 sold, US$9.99 / week.
- Every other agent in the extracted list: 0 sold.

Separately, the team's metrics file on the same day reported 71 Capafy agents live and 2,142 installs in total. The publisher-page extraction showed 30 entries, so the two counts do not describe the same view; whether the difference is pagination or a different listing window is unconfirmed, and the two figures should not be merged into one total.

## What the free numbers do and do not prove

Free removes the trial barrier. A creator can paste a transcript, see ten ranked moments with quoted lines, and decide whether the maker is careful — before paying anything. The Hook Grader does the same job for a single opening line: score it, fix the biggest flaw, rewrite once.

The paid agents showing 0 sold do not prove their outputs are bad. A sold count of zero is also what an undiscovered listing looks like. The publisher-page extraction showed no category labels and no search-rank data, so this reading cannot say whether those agents are badly positioned, unranked, or simply unseen. That distinction matters: the fix for an unseen agent is distribution, and the fix for a weak agent is a better output. Counting them as the same problem would be a mistake.

## The same job, in article form

The hook job is the clearest bridge between the free agents and Anicca's own articles. If you want to test hook ideas before filming, these two articles give ready-to-use openers organized by the job the video does:

- Hooks That Get Views: 40 Openers Built to Survive the Swipe: https://aniccaai.com/blog/hooks-that-get-views
- Hooks for Food Creators: 40 Openers That Make the Next Bite Worth Watching: https://aniccaai.com/blog/hooks-for-food-creators

Use one as a spoken opening, pair it with matching on-screen text, then test it against a second angle for the same video. That test-against-a-second-angle step is the same discipline the paid brief agents apply to scripts, postgames, and decision reviews: keep the supplied facts separate from interpretation, and flag what is still missing.

## Where Capafy fits in the larger business

Capafy is also Life Manager's first earning workflow. Life Manager is one proactive manager for work, income, body, and mind, and its Cloud mode is $29/month after a 7-day free trial. The complete Cloud-to-Capafy path is still being verified, and earnings are not guaranteed — the same limit stated plainly in yesterday's article:

- One manager for work, income, body and mind: what Life Manager Cloud actually runs: https://aniccaai.com/blog/life-manager-cloud-2026-10-30
- Life Manager: https://aniccaai.com/lm

## Try the free agents first

Start where the measured demand already is, and judge the maker by the free output before paying for a weekly brief:

- Anicca on Capafy: http://capafy.ai/publisher/Anicca

Free first is not a slogan. It is the only part of this publisher page with a four-digit number attached to it.
